title.en: Isaacman wants a new home in orbit. Who can make the economics work?
title.zh: 艾萨克曼要找太空新家：谁能算赢这笔账？

summary.en: NASA invites commercial station proposals by December8, with awards expected spring2027. A solicitation is not a selected or operational replacement.
summary.zh: NASA征集商业空间站方案，12月8日截止，预计2027年春授标。征集并非已选定或已运行的替代站。

title.en: Anthropic prices a million input tokens at ten cents. Where is the catch?
title.zh: Anthropic百万输入token卖一毛美元：便宜到哪一步？

summary.en: Haiku5.5 has a lower price for prompts up to100,000tokens. Longer prompts use a higher tier; output, retries and task success still matter.
summary.zh: Haiku5.5对不超过10万token的提示词设低价。更长提示用高价档，输出、重试与任务成功仍影响成本。
